statement: Let Ω ⊂ R2 be bounded and open, let g ∈ L∞(Ω), and let (u, K) be an admissible absolute minimizer for Fg as defined in Section 1.1. In particular, K is relatively closed, H1(K) < ∞, and u ∈ L2(Ω) ∩ W1,2(Ω \ K); no rectifiability of K is assumed. Then u ∈ L∞ loc(Ω) ∩ SBVloc(Ω), H1 (K \ Ju) = 0. The function satisfies ∆u = u−g on Ω\K and has there a C1,α loc representative for every α ∈ (0, 1). If the pair is reduced, then K = sptΩ(H1 ⌞Ju) = Ju Ω . (2.1) 4 Consequently, in the reduced case, on every smooth open set W ⋐ Ω, the restricted pair is a reduced rectifiable absolute minimizer with bounded function.
